2xs.comment: Tight gaps inside a control (icon + label).

xs.comment: Gap between related controls in a tool group.

sm.comment: Padding inside compact surfaces, list rows.

md.comment: Default padding and gap between groups.

lg.comment: Card padding, gap between page sections.

height-sm.comment: Compact controls in dense tables and toolbars (desktop only).

height.comment: Default height of buttons, inputs, selects, tabs.

height-lg.comment: Prominent single actions; equals the touch target.

touch-target.comment: Minimum hit area (44px) on coarse pointers / mobile.

inline-target.comment: Minimum hit area (24px, WCAG 2.5.8) for inline text links on desktop; becomes touch-target below the tablet breakpoint.

icon-sm.comment: Inline icon size next to sm/compact text.

icon-md.comment: Default icon size in buttons and navigation.

padding-x-sm.comment: Horizontal padding of small buttons and inputs.

page-max.comment: Max content width of standard pages (1180px).

page-wide-max.comment: Max width for viewer / explorer pages (1600px).

page-pad.comment: Page padding on tablet and desktop.

dialog-width.comment: All standard dialogs share one width.

readable-max.comment: Max line length for leads and help text.

tablet.comment: min-width for tablet layouts (media queries cannot read vars; keep CSS in sync).
